description_ru: Современные озерно-болотные отложения. Суглинки иловатые, редко глины, супеси, пески, сапропели, торф
note: GGK-200 N-42-V (Geologicheskaya karta SSSR 1:200 000, 1st edition; Novosibirsk TGU, author L.Ya. Kazantseva, ed. S.B. Shatsky; approved 1973, printed 1976; 70-71E 55d20m-56dN). Titled 'geological map and map of mineral resources', but its legend lists only Quaternary units + undivided pre-Quaternary (the Quaternary map of the plain). RASTER = geokniga 2000x2379 px PREVIEW (~34 m/px); vertical lithology ruling removed (work/r200d/prep_vlines.py); tints calibrated on the map (preview_tint_calib.py); lakes = WATER; saIII (subaerial cover loams) coded E (PI decision 2026-10-04); a,LII-IIIkrs appears only on the sections; frame = 4 corners on the inner edge of the neatline + 9 interior 15x10 min graticule crossings + 11 graticule-at-frame ties; the BL corner was set by eye (frame tools locked on a margin line 13 px lower); the print is distorted by up to ~5 px (LOO 42 m) (r200i)
